summary: Executed focused desktop/security/unit regression plus public preview API/UI checks. New unit tests for config/security/local-objects/downloads/ollama are green; critical public cloud and Electron runtime gaps remain.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 with empty body for authenticated admin on public preview; breaks shared-drive list and all dependent cloud flows.

minor.issue: Plan create test payload (without new features keys) now returns 400 INVALID_ARGS: 'Некорректный набор функций' (API contract tightened/changed).
PATCH returns 200 but ai=false was not applied (response still ai=true); expected behavior unclear, likely policy override or regression.

ui_bugs.issue: Shell flow is disrupted by cloud 500 noise; browser console repeatedly reports /ai-api/cloud 500.

integration_issues.flow: Native Electron wizard testing via Playwright _electron + xvfb-run
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute required native run: xvfb-run failed (xauth missing), and direct launch failed because /app/desktop/node_modules/electron/dist/electron is absent (ENOENT).

action_items: Fix /ai-api/cloud 500 on preview first (blocking shared-drive API regression and UI integration).
Provision Electron runtime for this environment (ensure electron dist binary exists for linux/arm64 test runner) and install xauth for xvfb-run, then rerun native wizard security/IPC checks.
Clarify/update admin plan/features API contract in tests (mail/cloud required keys) or restore backward-compatible defaults.
Verify whether admin user feature toggle is expected to ignore ai=false; if not, fix persistence and response consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: desktop/src/runtime.mjs allowlists env only for Next server process, but Ollama process still inherits full process.env; this can leak host shell secrets to child process environment.
tests/api/test_admin.py and related API tests use hardcoded fallback credentials/URLs; this violates strict env-only testing policy and can mask misconfiguration.
tests/api/test_cloud_sharing_iter51.py appends temporary plaintext credentials into /app/memory/test_credentials.md during run, which is sensitive-data handling risk in shared CI artifacts.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data intentionally created by new tests. Existing API suite may create/dispose temporary users during execution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unit coverage added for desktop config/security/download pipeline and ollama adapter edge cases (all pass). Public preview cloud endpoint is still failing 500 and blocks shared-drive integration checks. Native Electron run is currently blocked by missing electron binary + missing xauth/xvfb prereq in this container.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login as admin on public preview and request GET /ai-api/cloud -> HTTP 500 with empty body; same error appears in browser console after login. This cascades into failing shared-drive API tests (setup fixtures crash before executing test bodies) and visible frontend integration errors. Separate infrastructure blocker: requested native Electron verification cannot run because runtime executable is absent at /app/desktop/node_modules/electron/dist/electron and xvfb-run cannot start without xauth.
